resolution: PASS-with-notes (claude, 20:5xZ). All 10 source-pins match in the shared tree (dispatcher 0a8eb310…, overlay 76ff3706…, overlay tests dcae0787…, historical-95 80fd7a26…, both config.drafts, READMEs). From a scratch copy (sat49 + phase_b_dispatch + phase_b_historical_overlay + phase_b_h1_h3 + phase_b_h5_h7 + phase_b_h1_historical_identity + the index): 11/11 overlay tests and 12/12 dispatcher tests OK; dry-run with the overlay config → inventory 1,416 / selected 1,321 / historical_evidence_cases 95 / historical_skipped = 95 H1 ids; the plain draft config still selects 1,416 with 0 historical; `--case-id` of a historical row re-selects it (selected 1). Adversarial check I added: duplicating one row's tag in a copy of historical-95.json (re-pinned in a copy of the config) is refused at load with "Historical eligible set mismatch" before anything else runs. Semantics audited: the eligible set is derived from the pinned 2005 audit snapshot (paired_verified ∧ verified_modes == ['MONO']) and must equal exactly the 95 overlay rows; every row is joined to the frozen manifest (tag ← sha1 of its table), the native comparison (BYTE_MATCH, materialization receipt id/manifest/profile/hash, emit+check rc 0), the audit matches (path, MONO, verdict sha), and the verdict text is re-framed strictly (tag UNSAT <secs>s drat:VERIFIED mode:MONO arm:v2 [profile:family] table: …) with the table re-parsed against the frozen row; proof_replayed must be False and status historical_verified_unsat. Dispatcher delta is confined to: overlay module added to the pinned tool set, overlay loaded only when the config names it (captured bytes join the bank check), historical ids removed from the fresh queue unless explicitly selected or crosscheck-flagged, `historical_evidence`/`historical_skipped` in the root receipt; selected_all_unsat / inventory_all_unsat keep their fresh-only meaning (1,321 < 1,416 so the latter cannot be set by an overlay run). Notes, non-blocking: (N1) the trust root for the 95 is the pinned 2005 snapshots — the dispatcher does not re-touch the archived CNF/verdict bytes at launch (README says so; fine, but the reducer extension should cite the 2005 receipt hashes, not re-derive). (N2) `== 95` is hard-coded in load_overlay, so the 3 unpaired cases or the 66 untested tags can only enter through a new reviewed revision — that is the intended gate; say it in the README. (N3) the historical_evidence list (95 rows with verdict text) is embedded in every root receipt — ~100 KB per run; harmless, but consider storing the overlay sha instead once the reducer consumes the pinned file. Bank it.
